-- ============================================================
-- DEADLINE ESP
-- X = OFF/ON
-- ============================================================

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local WS         = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local G  = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

if type(G.DeadlineESP_Cleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(G.DeadlineESP_Cleanup)
end

-- ============================================================
-- CONFIG
-- ============================================================

local CFG = {
    ColorAlive   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
    ColorDead    = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
    ColorStroke  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    FillAlpha    = 0.6,
    StrokeAlpha  = 0.2,
    ThroughWalls = true,
    SkipSelf     = true,
}

-- ============================================================
-- STATE
-- ============================================================

local enabled    = false
local active     = {}
local ignoreSelf = {}
local myUserId   = tostring(LP.UserId)

local attrNames = {"userid", "UserId", "user_id", "PlayerId"}

-- ============================================================
-- HELPERS
-- ============================================================

local function isMyModel(model)
    if not CFG.SkipSelf then return false end
    local cached = ignoreSelf[model]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end

    for i = 1, 4 do
        local v = model:GetAttribute(attrNames[i])
        if v and tostring(v) == myUserId then
            ignoreSelf[model] = true
            return true
        end
    end
    for _, ch in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local v = ch:GetAttribute(attrNames[i])
            if v and tostring(v) == myUserId then
                ignoreSelf[model] = true
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    ignoreSelf[model] = false
    return false
end

local function addESP(model, isDead)
    if active[model] then return end

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = "DL_HL"
    hl.FillColor = isDead and CFG.ColorDead or CFG.ColorAlive
    hl.OutlineColor = CFG.ColorStroke
    hl.FillTransparency = CFG.FillAlpha
    hl.OutlineTransparency = CFG.StrokeAlpha
    hl.DepthMode = CFG.ThroughWalls
        and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        or  Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    hl.Parent = model

    active[model] = hl
end

local function removeESP(model)
    local hl = active[model]
    if hl then
        hl:Destroy()
        active[model] = nil
    end
end

local function clearAll()
    for model in pairs(active) do
        removeESP(model)
    end
    ignoreSelf = {}
end

-- ============================================================
-- FOLDERS
-- ============================================================

local aliveFolder, deadFolder

local function refreshFolders()
    aliveFolder = WS:FindFirstChild("characters")
    local ignore = WS:FindFirstChild("ignore")
    deadFolder = ignore and ignore:FindFirstChild("ragdolls")
    if not deadFolder then
        deadFolder = WS:FindFirstChild("ragdolls")
    end
end

refreshFolders()

-- ============================================================
-- EVENTS
-- ============================================================

local conns = {}

local function onAdded(model, isDead)
    if not enabled then return end
    if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
    if isMyModel(model) then return end
    addESP(model, isDead)
end

local function onRemoved(model)
    if active[model] then removeESP(model) end
    ignoreSelf[model] = nil
end

local function unhook()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    conns = {}
end

local function hookFolder(folder, isDead)
    if not folder then return end
    table.insert(conns, folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(m) onAdded(m, isDead) end))
    table.insert(conns, folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(onRemoved))
end

local function rehook()
    unhook()
    hookFolder(aliveFolder, false)
    hookFolder(deadFolder, true)
end

rehook()

-- ============================================================
-- SCAN
-- ============================================================

local function scan()
    if not aliveFolder or not deadFolder then
        refreshFolders()
        rehook()
    end

    if aliveFolder then
        for _, m in ipairs(aliveFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and not isMyModel(m) then
                addESP(m, false)
            end
        end
    end
    if deadFolder then
        for _, m in ipairs(deadFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and not isMyModel(m) then
                addESP(m, true)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- TOGGLE
-- ============================================================

local function turnOn()
    enabled = true
    scan()
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(active) do n += 1 end
    print("[DeadlineESP] ON | " .. n)
end

local function turnOff()
    enabled = false
    clearAll()
    print("[DeadlineESP] OFF")
end

-- ============================================================
-- INPUT
-- ============================================================

local inputConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
        if enabled then turnOff() else turnOn() end
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- CLEANUP
-- ============================================================

G.DeadlineESP_Cleanup = function()
    if inputConn then inputConn:Disconnect() inputConn = nil end
    unhook()
    turnOff()
    G.DeadlineESP_Cleanup = nil
end

print("[DeadlineESP] loaded | X = ON/OFF")

--========================================================--
-- GOJO NPC KILLER
-- R6 + R15 | MOBILE + PC
--
-- Blue            = 3s cooldown
-- Red             = 5s cooldown + red explosion
-- Hollow Purple   = 10s cooldown + BIG
-- Limitless Fly   = 5s cooldown / INFINITE FLIGHT
-- Teleport        = 3s cooldown
--
-- LIMITLESS FLY:
-- • Infinite duration
-- • Control with WASD / mobile joystick
-- • Camera controls direction
-- • Unequip tool to stop flying
-- NPC ONLY
--========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local Character
local Humanoid
local Root

local function SetupCharacter(char)

	Character = char
	Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	Root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

end

SetupCharacter(
	Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
)

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local BLUE_DAMAGE = 35
local RED_DAMAGE = 50
local PURPLE_DAMAGE = 500

local NPC_PUSH = 35
local NPC_FREEZE_TIME = 2.5

local BLUE_COOLDOWN = 3
local RED_COOLDOWN = 5
local PURPLE_COOLDOWN = 10
local FLY_COOLDOWN = 5
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 3

local FLY_SPEED = 75

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 35

local BLUE_SPEED = 50
local RED_SPEED = 135
local PURPLE_SPEED = 180

local BLUE_SIZE = 1.5
local RED_SIZE = 1.8
local PURPLE_SIZE = 5

--========================================================--
-- SOUNDS
--========================================================--

local SOUND = {
	BlueCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	BlueFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	RedCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	RedFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	PurpleCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	PurpleFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	Impact = "rbxassetid://12222152",

	Teleport = "rbxassetid://5568266006",

	FlyStart = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	FlyEnd = "rbxassetid://12222152",
}

--========================================================--
-- COOLDOWNS
--========================================================--

local Cooldown = {
	Blue = false,
	Red = false,
	Purple = false,
	Fly = false,
	Teleport = false
}

local function TryCooldown(name, time)

	if Cooldown[name] then
		return false
	end

	Cooldown[name] = true

	task.delay(time, function()
		Cooldown[name] = false
	end)

	return true
end

--========================================================--
-- SOUND
--========================================================--

local function PlaySound(id, volume, speed)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1

	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 5

	sound.Parent = Root

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 10)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC CHECK
--========================================================--

local function GetNPC(part)

	if not part then
		return nil
	end

	local model =
		part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

	if not model then
		return nil
	end

	if model == Character then
		return nil
	end

	-- NEVER target players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
		return nil
	end

	local humanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return model
end

--========================================================--
-- RED EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function RedExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "RedExplosion"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		20,
		20
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		0,
		0
	)

	light.Brightness = 15
	light.Range = 30
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.4,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Impact,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.5
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- PURPLE EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function PurpleExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "HollowPurpleExplosion"

	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		180,
		0,
		255
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		190,
		50,
		255
	)

	light.Brightness = 30
	light.Range = 50
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.7,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(30, 30, 30),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.8
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC HIT
--========================================================--

local function DamageNPC(
	npc,
	damage,
	direction,
	ability
)

	local humanoid =
		npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	local npcRoot =
		npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- NEVER damage players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(npc) then
		return
	end

	-- DAMAGE
	humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

	-- RED EFFECT
	if ability == "Red" and npcRoot then
		RedExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PURPLE EFFECT
	if ability == "Purple" and npcRoot then
		PurpleExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PUSH
	if npcRoot and direction then

		local push =
			Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

		push.MaxForce =
			Vector3.new(
				100000,
				100000,
				100000
			)

		push.Velocity =
			direction.Unit *
			NPC_PUSH
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				8,
				0
			)

		push.Parent = npcRoot

		Debris:AddItem(
			push,
			0.15
		)

	end

	-- FREEZE
	local oldWalk =
		humanoid.WalkSpeed

	local oldJump =
		humanoid.JumpPower

	local oldRotate =
		humanoid.AutoRotate

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	task.delay(
		NPC_FREEZE_TIME,
		function()

			if humanoid
				and humanoid.Parent
				and humanoid.Health > 0
			then

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					oldWalk

				humanoid.JumpPower =
					oldJump

				humanoid.AutoRotate =
					oldRotate

			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE PROJECTILE
--========================================================--

local function CreateOrb(
	color,
	size
)

	local orb =
		Instance.new("Part")

	orb.Name = "GojoProjectile"

	orb.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	orb.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	orb.Color =
		color

	orb.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			size,
			size,
			size
		)

	orb.CanCollide = false
	orb.CanTouch = true
	orb.CanQuery = false

	orb.CastShadow = false

	orb.Parent = workspace

	local light =
		Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color =
		color

	light.Brightness =
		size * 7

	light.Range =
		size * 8

	light.Parent =
		orb

	return orb
end

--========================================================--
-- SHOOT
--========================================================--

local function Shoot(
	color,
	size,
	speed,
	lifetime,
	damage,
	fireSound,
	ability
)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local direction =
		camera.CFrame.LookVector

	local orb =
		CreateOrb(

			size
		)

	orb.CFrame =

			+
			direction * 4
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				1,
				0
			)
		)

	local velocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	velocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

		direction * speed

	velocity.Parent =
		orb

	PlaySound(
		fireSound,
		1.5,
		1
	)

	local hit = false
	local connection

	connection =
		orb.Touched:Connect(
			function(part)

				if hit then
					return
				end

				local npc =
					GetNPC(part)

				if npc then

					hit = true

					DamageNPC(

						damage,
						direction,
						ability
					)

					if connection then
						connection:Disconnect()
					end

					orb:Destroy()

				end

			end
		)

	Debris:AddItem(
		orb,
		lifetime
	)

	task.delay(
		lifetime,
		function()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--

local function UseBlue()

	if not TryCooldown(

		BLUE_COOLDOWN
	) then

	end

	PlaySound(

	Shoot(

end

	PlaySound(

--========================================================--
-- LIMITLESS FLY
--========================================================--

local Flying = false
local FlyConnection
local FlyVelocity
local FlyTool

local function StopFly()

	if not Flying then
		return
	end

	Flying = false

	if FlyConnection then
		FlyConnection:Disconnect()
		FlyConnection = nil
	end

	if FlyVelocity then
		FlyVelocity:Destroy()
		FlyVelocity = nil
	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyEnd,
		1.2,
		1.2
	)

end

local function StartFly()

	if Flying then
		return
	end

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Fly",
		FLY_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root or not Humanoid then
		return
	end

	Flying = true

	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyStart,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	FlyVelocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	FlyVelocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	FlyVelocity.Velocity =
		Vector3.zero

	FlyVelocity.Parent =
		Root

	FlyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
			function()

				if not Flying then
					return
				end

				if not Root
					or not Root.Parent
					or not Humanoid
					or Humanoid.Health <= 0
				then

					StopFly()
					return

				end

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				if not camera then
					return
				end

				-- Get normal player movement
				local moveDirection =
					Humanoid.MoveDirection

				-- Camera direction
				local cameraLook =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				local cameraRight =
					camera.CFrame.RightVector

				-- Convert normal movement into
				-- camera-relative 3D flight movement.
				local forwardAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraLook.X,
							0,
							cameraLook.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local rightAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraRight.X,
							0,
							cameraRight.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local direction =
					Vector3.zero

				-- Forward/backward follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraLook *
					forwardAmount

				-- Left/right follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraRight *
					rightAmount

				-- Preserve vertical camera direction
				-- when moving forward/backward.
				if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then

					direction =
						direction.Unit

					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						direction *
						FLY_SPEED

					-- Face the direction of flight
					Root.CFrame =
						CFrame.lookAt(
							Root.Position,
							Root.Position +
							direction
						)

				else

					-- No movement = hover in place
					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						Vector3.zero

				end

			end
		)

end

local function UseTeleport()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Teleport",
		TELEPORT_COOLDOWN
	) then

	if not Root then

	local params =

	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {

	}

	local result =
		workspace:Raycast(
			Root.Position,
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE,
			params
		)

	local destination

	if result then

		destination =
			result.Position -
			direction * 3

	else

		destination =
			Root.Position +
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE

	Root.CFrame =

	if not Remote then

	local Success, Result = pcall(function()

		return Remote:InvokeServer(unpack(Arguments))

	end)

		warn("BLUEKIDD F3X ERROR:", Result)

        return
    end
    for player, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local headPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
                    local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - pos.Y) * 1.8
                    local width = height / 2
                    objs.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    objs.box.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X - width/2, pos.Y - height/2)
                    objs.box.Visible = true
                    objs.name.Text = player.Name .. " [" .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. "]"
                    objs.name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y - height/2 - 20)
                    objs.name.Visible = true
                end
            else
                objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
        end
    end
end)

    if state.fovEnabled and cam then
        local targetFOV = state.fovValue or 120
        if cam.FieldOfView ~= targetFOV then
            cam.FieldOfView = targetFOV
        end
    end
    if state.zoomEnabled then
        if LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance ~= 1000 then
            LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000
        end
    end
end)
